derivation_policy.course_clipping: Derived segment cut between the nearest positions of the legal endpoints on a complete, original-node-connected physical chain. Original interior vertices retained; interpolated endpoints and unsnapped connectors explicitly reported.
derivation_policy.legal_connectors: Every gap from a printed legal point to an original physical course is measured and disclosed; a connector is a hypothesis, not unchanged source geometry.
derivation_policy.straight_segments: Only the ordinary printed polygonal runs. A named physical exception cannot silently become a straight chord.
derivation_policy.common_boundary: Both decisions are reconstructed as printed; the RP4201 exception is not silently transferred from Sidi to Ben Mansour. No remainder polygon or forced partition.

open_issues: Explicit unsnapped endpoint connectors to modern OSM coastline yield self-intersections in both candidates: Ben Mansour near Lambert(406541.696529,450442.403999), Sidi Mohamed Benmansour near Lambert(397703.539200,432986.111747). No candidate is repaired or admitted to runtime.
Ben Mansour 13–14 and Sidi 12–13 have identical legal endpoints but only Sidi explicitly follows RP4201. Need authoritative annex/correction or field/cadastral clarification.
Some river/coast endpoint offsets exceed the 7 m transformation accuracy and are explicitly unresolved. Modern OSM courses cannot certify the 2020 legal endpoint positions.
Oued Fekroun versus OSM Canal Boufakroune is a plausible physical identification supported by endpoints, not an official alias certificate.
